title: Local history and editable recovery
summary: Keep recent captures and saved revisions in a local Library, with thumbnails and editable snapshot recovery.

Added: Persistent local snapshots on opening, creating, pasting, capturing and explicit saving. Up to 50 snapshots and 512 MB of retained data.
Library thumbnails, recent-image tray and File > Open Recent reopen editable copies with unsaved-change protection.
Shared CLI history list, record and open commands.
Protected: Atomic index updates and a process lock merge snapshots from multiple windows. Missing or corrupt history leaves the open image intact.
Verified: Native revision recovery restores seven objects and matches all 256000 pixels; restart and missing-file recovery verified.
Real capture and Open Recent recovery each match 256000 synthetic pixels. 90 regular Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy.

limitations: Edits after the last snapshot require saving; per-edit recovery and retention preferences are planned.
Search, tags/folders, bulk import and full reference Library layout remain unfinished.
Expired snapshot deletion failures are reported and may leave files on disk; the open image remains intact.
